metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Shanghai increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 for tropospheric nitrogen dioxide - Two time periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 and Apr 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Shanghai, China (approximate coordinates: 31.23°N, 121.47°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P NO2 has a quality assurance band (qa_value) - Should filter for qa_value >= 0.75 for good quality pixels - This is about NO2 levels, not clouds, so quality filtering is appropriate 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - NO2 values are in mol/m² and typically range from 0 to ~0.0003 - Zero or very low values are valid (could indicate clean air) - Need to check: collection size, pixel counts after masking, and valid numeric results - Compare mean values between two periods to determine if there was an increase ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.47, 31.23]).buffer(50000); // 50km radius around Shanghai const period1Start = '2020-02-10'; const period1End = '2020-02-26'; const period2Start = '2020-04-20'; const period2End = '2020-05-13'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const col1 = no2Collection .filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(shanghai); const col2 = no2Collection .filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(shanghai); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing with quality filtering function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.updateMask(mask); } const col1Masked = col1.map(maskQuality); const col2Masked = col2.map(maskQuality); const mean1 = col1Masked.mean(); const mean2 = col2Masked.mean(); // 4. Calculation const stats1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: shanghai, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: shanghai, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const val2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Period 1: Mean NO2 = ${val1}, Valid pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2: Mean NO2 = ${val2}, Valid pixels = ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (val1 === null || val1 === undefined || val2 === null || val2 === undefined || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log('Calculation failed: invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Change: ${((val2 - val1) / val1 * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (val2 > val1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
